profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, traded under the ticker XPEV. Its Spanish market site presents a fully electric range under the slogan "Xpande tu mundo" and says the company has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014. The site is operated for the Spanish market, and it names CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the party responsible for processing the data of visitors who leave their details to be contacted about test drives or product information.

The models described on the site are the G6, G9 and P7⁺. XPENG describes them as combining artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the SEPA 2.0 800-volt electric platform, which the company says allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three models carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years / 160.000 km, according to the site.

The site also sets out financing offers, which it states are subject to review and approval by Open Bank, S.A. For the G6 RWD Standard Range it lists a cash price of 41.122,71€ and a financed price of 37.522,71 €, and for the G9 RWD Standard Range a cash price of 56.590,30€. The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001810997.
